# Machines & Cloud

> Machines & Cloud builds an AI front desk for Houston home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning). Three services: Answer ($397 per month after a one-time $1,497 build; answers calls, texts, website chat, and Angi, Thumbtack, or Google Local Services leads within a minute, states only published fees, hands emergencies to the owner; phone answering on the existing number is included with 300 minutes a month, then $0.35 a minute), Book and confirm (included: two hour windows, reminders, on-the-way texts, reschedule by reply, booking into Google Calendar, Jobber, or Housecall Pro), and Follow up ($197 per month add-on with 500 texts: same-day review request to every customer, day 14 quote follow-up, chasing quiet leads, maintenance reminders with consent). 7 day pilot on the business's real site and phone; the build fee is refunded in full on cancellation by day 7. No contract. Founder led, Houston based.
